name: WholeStack WF-024: Official County Tax Evidence Adapter

parameters.jsCode: const meta=$('Split Tax Sources').item.json; const raw=$json; const status=Number(raw.statusCode||200); let body=raw.body??raw.data??raw; if(typeof body!=='string') body=JSON.stringify(body); let parsed=null; try{parsed=JSON.parse(body);}catch(e){} const rows=parsed?(Array.isArray(parsed)?parsed:(parsed.records||parsed.data||parsed.features||[])):[]; const arr=Array.isArray(rows)?rows:[]; const pick=(a,keys)=>{for(const k of keys){if(a?.[k]!==undefined&&a?.[k]!==null&&String(a[k]).trim()!=='')return a[k];}return null;}; const normMoney=v=>{if(v===null||v===undefined||v==='')return null; const n=Number(String(v).replace(/[$,]/g,'')); return Number.isFinite(n)?n:null;}; const records=arr.slice(0,meta.limit).map(r=>{const a=r.attributes&&typeof r.attributes==='object'?r.attributes:r; const delinquent=normMoney(pick(a,['delinquent_tax_amount','delinquent_tax','tax_delinquent_amount','past_due_tax','past_due','amount_due'])); const statusText=String(pick(a,['tax_status','status','tax_state','delinquency_status'])||''); const explicit=/delinquent|past due|default|unpaid|in arrears/i.test(statusText); const signal=(delinquent!==null&&delinquent>0)||explicit?'tax_delinquent':null; return {source_record_id:String(pick(a,['parcel_id','parcelid','parcel','pin','pid','tax_account','account_number','record_id','id','objectid','OBJECTID'])||''),source_url:meta.source.url,source_observed_at:new Date().toISOString(),owner_name:pick(a,['owner_name','owner','ownname','taxpayer_name','taxpayer']),property_address:pick(a,['property_address','site_address','situs_address','address','situs']),parcel_id:pick(a,['parcel_id','parcelid','parcel','pin','pid','nparno']),signal,signal_strength:signal?'confirmed':'needs_review',structured_facts:{tax_status:pick(a,['tax_status','status','tax_state','delinquency_status']),delinquent_tax_amount:delinquent,tax_due_date:pick(a,['tax_due_date','due_date']),tax_amount:normMoney(pick(a,['tax_amount','annual_tax','total_tax'])),raw:a},raw_attributes:a};}).filter(r=>r.signal); return [{json:{success:status>=200&&status<300,request_id:meta.request_id,criterion:'tax_delinquent',source:meta.source,records,limitations:status>=400?['Official tax source returned HTTP '+status+'.']:[],missing_fields:records.filter(r=>!r.owner_name||!r.property_address).map(r=>r.source_record_id||'unknown'),policy:'Only explicit delinquency fields/statuses create a tax_delinquent signal; missing or ambiguous tax data is not treated as delinquent.'}}];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({success:true,request_id:$('Prepare Tax Source Requests').first().json.request_id,criterion_results:$input.all().map(i=>i.json),policy:'Official tax evidence is traceable to the source URL/record; downstream review is required before outreach.'}) }}
